title: The 'Bama State Revellers and Collegians
summary: He joined the second jazz band, the Revellers, with Dud Bascomb, Bob Range and Haywood Henry, and the band later became the Collegians under him.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: And what happened when you went to the band room?
Well, I stayed in there. And then, they originated the second band called 'Bama State Revellers. They already had the 'Bama State Collegians. Just one band.
Okay. What was that band like?

Jazz. Jazz. And it was like, this was the band that had Dud Bascomb in. Jimmy Mitchelle was in it. Bob Range was in this band. All of us. Haywood Henry was in this band, and a few others. I can't think of the rest of the boys.
But, it was second band. 'Bama State Collegians was the first one. So, most of the fellows were finishing out at 'Bama the next year.

So, I stayed in there and we got the band going. Then, we got very popular on the campus. Jimmy Mitchelle was the leader of the 'Bama State Revellers. So, after the first band went out, then they made the 'Bama State Revellers the 'Bama State Collegians. Then, they made me the leader of the Collegians. And it was all jazz. We had a lot of fun.
